Mesh Msg

group TIME_MESH_MSG

Definitions for mesh message types used by time models.

Defines

MAX_UNCERTAINTY 255

Maximum allowable uncertainty value.

IS_TIME_ROLE_VALID(role) (role <= TIME_ROLE_CLIENT)

Macro to validate if a time role is within range.

Typedefs

typedef uint8_t time_role_t

Type alias matching _time_role_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Enums

enum _time_role_t

Enumeration for possible time roles a node can assume. Use time_role_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Values:

enumerator TIME_ROLE_NONE

Node has no specific time role.

enumerator TIME_ROLE_AUTHORITY

Node acts as time authority.

enumerator TIME_ROLE_RELAY

Node relays time information.

enumerator TIME_ROLE_CLIENT

Node requests time information.

struct tai_time_t

Structure representing TAI (Temps Atomique International) time.

Public Members

uint8_t tai_seconds[5]

TAI seconds since epoch, little-endian format.

uint8_t subsecond

Subsecond precision from 0-255 in units of 1/256 second.

uint8_t uncertainty

Uncertainty in the time accuracy in units of 10ms.

uint16_t time_authority

Indicates if the node is an authoritative time source.

uint16_t tai_utc_delta

Signed value representing the TAI-UTC delta.

uint8_t time_zone_offset

Time zone offset in 15-minute increments from UTC.
